cases: Accepted V554 F1 input collection is empty.

negative.meaning: Exact upstream V554 target-use authority denies structural use; V555 emits no route.
A valid upstream F1 does not match any active route-rule entry, including an F1 without an exact nonnull structural_channel_ref under tranche-one V555-RR-001; no route is invented.

missing.meaning: A route-rule match is otherwise identified but a statically required exact route authority/reference cannot be resolved; no route is emitted.
Required exact identity/provenance fields cannot produce one deterministic route identity; no route is emitted.

unknown.meaning: Unknown future V554 authority/rule/signature versions are not grandfathered or rematched. They require a new governed V555 registry entry.

deferred.meaning: Lawful unresolved actor/runtime/genealogy applicability remains inherited from V554 F2 by exact reference; it does not block structurally governed V555 route creation unless upstream V554 structural use is denied, and it is never asserted satisfied.

forbidden_inference_and_defaults: No actor_id, actor position fact, membership, relationship, encounter, exposure, traversal, response, memory, biography or psyche may participate in route identity or authorization.

No interpolation, temporal proxy, backfill, nearest-wave substitution or geography imputation.

No TRANSMIT/BUFFER/AMPLIFY/DEFLECT/BLOCK declaration from route existence alone.
No REROUTE or cross-route interaction/topology in V555.
No descriptive/fuzzy rematching, silent signature downgrade or future-version fallback.

GOVERNING_SPIRIT_CHECK.ambiguity: Hard authority fixes atomic route grain and requires one governed mediation locus/channel structural role, while accepted ADP-001 carries an exact producer-governed structural-channel identity when that identity is present and required. It does not require an additional domain-specific V555 locus taxonomy. The remaining lawful choice is whether tranche one stays wholly VALID_EMPTY pending some further route-shape source, or binds the already-governed exact channel as the minimal locus.
lawful_alternatives: Keep the tranche-one registry wholly VALID_EMPTY until some additional governed route-shape source is accepted.
Bind only the exact producer-governed structural-channel identity already carried by a matching accepted F1 as the V555 mediation locus, with lawful absence when that identity is unavailable.
GOVERNING_SPIRIT_CHECK.chosen_design: Bind only the exact producer-governed structural-channel identity already carried by a matching accepted F1; add no domain-specific locus classes; permit zero routes where no exact channel-bearing F1 matches.
decisive_principles: Do not hallucinate semantic authority to make downstream output vivid or nonempty.

CONSUMER_RELEASE_SUFFICIENCY.statement: ADP-002 closes MUST-002 route-rule semantics and is sufficient, once Vozhd accepts it, as an authority dependency for ADP-003, ADP-004 and ADP-011. It does not by itself release V555 production implementation.
remaining_independent_gates: RA-R00 V555 packet-order and ordinary implementation gates
